title: confed restore result
description: The `result` of `confed restore <page> --version N --json`: version N of the page written into its file as a local change, on top of the version it is based on; with --push, pushed as a new version.

from_base_version.description: The version the file was based on, and stays based on until pushed.

push.description: --push: the push of the restored page, as push.schema.json describes it.
